striker.description: A goal scorer who relies on explosive short-burst acceleration, clinical finishing ability, and aerial threat. Must outrun defenders and generate maximum power in tight spaces.
striker.role_demands: High explosiveness and acceleration are paramount. Strikers need powerful hip drive for shooting and jumping, strong single-leg balance for off-balance finishes, and symmetrical movement to cut in from either side.

winger.description: A wide attacker who provides pace, dribbling, and crossing ability. Must beat defenders with speed and technical skill along the flank.
winger.role_demands: Top-end sprint speed and acceleration are critical. Hip mobility enables explosive direction changes. Knee stability protects during high-speed cutting. Symmetry allows effective movement on both feet.

central_midfielder.description: The engine room of the team covering large distances, winning duels, and linking play between defence and attack.
central_midfielder.role_demands: High knee resilience for repeated stop-start running. Hip mobility supports rapid turning. Upright posture aids vision and passing. Symmetry ensures reliable movement in all directions over 90 minutes.

centre_back.description: A defensive anchor who must win aerial duels, make decisive tackles, and organise the defensive line.
centre_back.role_demands: Strong trunk posture stabilises heading and aerial challenges. Knee stability supports repeated jumping and landing. Explosiveness for recovery runs. Balance for jockeying attackers.

goalkeeper.description: The last line of defence who must react explosively to shots, command the penalty area, and distribute effectively.
goalkeeper.role_demands: Explosive lateral power for diving saves. Flexibility for extreme reaching positions. Balance for set-position readiness. Strong posture for commanding the box and shot-stopping.

point_guard.description: The floor general who orchestrates offence, creates for teammates, and must be lethal off the dribble.
point_guard.role_demands: Elite change of direction for creating separation. Symmetrical movement for going left and right equally. Balance for contested pull-up jumpers. Knee health essential for a high-usage position.

shooting_guard.description: A versatile scorer who can knock down shots off the catch, off the dribble, and attack the basket in transition.
shooting_guard.role_demands: Explosive off-ball cutting. Stable shooting base from balanced posture. Symmetric movement to attack from both sides. Knee resilience for repeated cutting and landing.

small_forward.description: The versatile wing player who must score in multiple ways, defend multiple positions, and impact the game in transition.
small_forward.role_demands: All-around athleticism. Hip mobility for drive-and-finish techniques. Symmetry for posting up either side. Explosive capacity for transition scoring.

power_forward.description: A versatile big who can play in the post, set screens, and stretch the floor with mid-range shooting.
power_forward.role_demands: High knee load from frequent post contact and low-stance defence. Explosive power for rebounding. Strong trunk for holding position. Flexibility supports extended reach in rebounding situations.

center.description: The rim anchor who dominates inside, protects the basket, and controls the glass.
center.role_demands: Dominant knee stability for absorbing contact in the post. Upright posture to stay tall on defence and in traffic. Balance for pivoting and finishing under pressure.

sprinter.description: A short-distance specialist maximising speed over 60–400 metres through explosive power and mechanical efficiency.
sprinter.role_demands: Maximum rate of force development and power output. Symmetrical mechanics reduce energy leakage. Hip mobility unlocks full stride length. Knee stability prevents hamstring and patellar injuries under maximal loading.

middle_distance.description: An 800m–1500m specialist who combines aerobic capacity with the speed to unleash a devastating finishing kick.
middle_distance.role_demands: Knee durability for high training volume. Symmetric gait pattern prevents overuse injuries. Hip mobility for efficient stride at race pace. Relaxed upper body reduces energy cost over multiple laps.

jumper.description: A high jump or long jump athlete combining technical approach mechanics with explosive takeoff power.
jumper.role_demands: Peak explosive power at takeoff. Balance through the approach and penultimate step. Hip mobility for flight position. Knee integrity under the high joint loads of jumping and landing.

thrower.description: A shot put, discus, or hammer athlete generating maximum rotational power from ground through upper body.
thrower.role_demands: Strong trunk posture transfers force efficiently from lower to upper body. Hip mobility and rotational range enable full wind-up. Explosive hip drive generates throwing velocity. Balance through the rotating throwing circle is critical.
